big: The RBI held a record 880.2 tonnes of gold by end-2025. Yet it bought only about 4 tonnes that year, down from 72.6 tonnes in 2024. So why did the gold share of reserves still grow? The price did the work.

lines: The RBI bought less. So why are reserves in gold bigger?
Value is tonnes times price. Higher prices lifted the worth of gold already held, even with little new buying. That is why gold is a growing share of India's forex reserves.
